description: This file defines a test implementation of a grain used in Orleans framework testing, specifically for error handling scenarios. It contains methods to set and get internal state, simulate delays, and throw exceptions to test error propagation.

classes.name: LocalErrorGrain
classes.description: A mock grain class used for error simulation in Orleans testing.

methods.description: Sets the internal variable 'm_a' to the provided value.

methods.name: SetB
methods.description: Sets the internal variable 'm_b' to the provided value.

methods.description: Throws an exception to simulate an error during execution.
